answer: Staked collateral with delayed unbonding resists sybil. An agent escrows capital to attest or earn; it freezes through a multi-epoch unbonding horizon and is slashed on a clone-correlation proof. A farm's cost becomes arithmetic: a thousand fakes are a thousand idle deposits, each proven duplicate forfeiting principal forever. Unit economics sink to a nadir that scales with the attack. A comet sheds mass only in its brief perihelion pass, then coasts cheaply; a sybil cluster sheds capital every epoch until drained. Honest agents stake once and mine the full horizon on that pledge.
